conversation_segments_changes: Keep outer state version=2; add replay_schema_version=1 inside each conversation record.
Return detached deep-copy records from get() so precommit server preparation cannot mutate the live durable state object.
Add request replay fingerprint bound to turn_id + request_kind + existing Responses identity fields, excluding stream and volatile transport metadata.
Persist exact canonical Responses payload with 6h TTL, <=512KiB per response, <=8MiB aggregate and <=32 stale fingerprints.
Expired or evicted payload retains its request fingerprint as a fail-closed tombstone.
Strict put surfaces NCM28/OSError, rolls back all in-memory mutations with deepcopy and marks persistence_blocked.
Once persistence_blocked, strict work fails before provider invocation.
server_changes: Compute replay fingerprint and consult durable state before the TurnAffinity completion-text cache.
Exact durable hit returns persisted canonical payload; stale/expired/legacy exact retry fails closed without provider.
For durable Codex conversation requests, never regenerate response/call/item IDs from completion_text cache.
After provider, build one canonical responses_payload once before any cache or reservation mutation.
Strictly persist progress + canonical payload; on failure return 503 with zero TurnAffinity mutation, zero reservation and zero identity-bearing client output.
Only after commit update TurnAffinity, then rehydrate or clear reservation.
Replay tool-call rehydrates only a persisted account that still exists in current pool; removed owner clears ghost reservation and fails closed without silently rebasing account/thread.
Replay final response clears stale reservation.
Stream and non-stream project the same persisted canonical payload; no resp_/rs_/call_/fc_/msg_ identifiers before commit.
non_goals: No change to NOTION_AGENT rotation, prompt modes, delegation or thread failover policy.
No hosted CI, live Notion traffic, production mutation or secret access.
